verdict.rationale: dlt's docs define incremental loading as loading only new or changed data rather than records already loaded, and say the product automates it. A merge disposition upserts and deduplicates on primary_key or merge_key, with full load available as a separate alternative. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cursor fields and automatic persisted state tracking between runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration that incremental syncs work as claimed.
